name: Data.CostsSquares.of_norm_sq_eq_mul_card_zpow
summary: For a fit family θ, |c(θ(ι))/c(1)|⁻² is a power of the norm of the modulus of θ(ι) times a constant, and the height of a constant family (empty product) is 0; `Data.IsFitFamily.heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul` concludes.

steps.claim: By equations over the arguments (θ, o).
steps.lean:
| _, o => o.heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul (@.prod _ ∅ id 1 nofun) (by simp) fun _ _ ↦
    ⟨-k, by simp_all [div_pow, card_𝔪, mul_zpow, field, twist_one_spec]⟩

steps.claim: For a fit family θ (o): apply `Data.IsFitFamily.heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul` to the empty product (height 0) with the exponent −k: by h and `Data.card_𝔪`, |c(θ(ι))/c(1)|⁻² = levelNorm(θ(ι))^{−k}·(the value at the trivial twist), the factors at the chosen places cancelling (`twist_one_spec`).
steps.lean:
| _, o => o.heightLe_of_eq_zpow_mul (@.prod _ ∅ id 1 nofun) (by simp) fun _ _ ↦
    ⟨-k, by simp_all [div_pow, card_𝔪, mul_zpow, field, twist_one_spec]⟩
